# Blenny release notes

<!-- Generated by scripts/release_tools.py from docs/changes and docs/releases. -->

## 1.0.0 — 2026-09-30

First public release. Earlier 0.x versions were private engineering milestones.

### Added

- Resume your saved management choice at startup, control login launch in Settings, and receive authenticated Sparkle updates.
- Use a native Organization Board, menu bar controls and Settings. Capabilities are shown for the actual observed items, including applications with several icons.
- Organize menu bar applications into Visible, Revealable and Hidden, and review visibility and order together before applying changes.
- Undo Changes restores the state before the latest successful Apply. Stop and Quit release visibility restrictions while keeping the order you chose.

### Changed

- Open one-time GitHub sponsorship by default from the menu bar's right-click menu.

### Fixed

- Apply changes safely on a fresh installation, then undo them and reopen Blenny without a spurious missing-backup error.
- Keep the three policy areas free of persistent scrollbars, and let the system overflow arrow take over expansion and collapse across the system languages represented by macOS 27 resource labels.

### Requirements and limitations

- During management, native Clock clicks cannot open Notification Center, and Now Playing or unattributed Gaming/Wine items may disappear. Some system items cannot be sorted; adjacency to the overflow arrow is not guaranteed. See README for tested workarounds and recovery.
- Requires Apple silicon and macOS 27 only. Blenny is self-signed and is not notarized by Apple; follow the README first-launch and permission instructions.
